title: Live From The VPS
style: electronic hip hop, 118 BPM, server room energy, data centre theme, dry wry male vocal, geeky pride without irony, Cloudflare and infrastructure as creative subject, punchy and confident, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
104.194.156.109
That's the address — that's the line
1.9 gigabytes of RAM
That's the brain — that's the plan
58 gigabytes of disk
Everything on it — that's the risk
71 percent used — getting close
But the stack is running — that's what counts most

[CHORUS]
Live from the VPS — we're here
Live from the VPS — no fear
Cloudflare in front — D1 behind
Live from the VPS — one of a kind
OpenClaw running at 18789
Live from the VPS — everything's fine

[VERSE 2]
Worker deployed — coreyai-api
Every endpoint live — no delay
D1 tables — all confirmed
Every schema — already learned
ZYNVAULT indexed — 57 files
Journal append-only — miles and miles
Every session state saved here
Live from the VPS — year by year

[BRIDGE — spoken]
It's not Silicon Valley. It's a $15/month server in a data centre. And it's running everything. That's the story.

[OUTRO]
Live from the VPS. Still running. Corey James McIvor. ZYNTHIO.
